qualification: Nine new deterministic scan cases cover repeatable/foreign/moved cursors, row/byte limits, exact lookahead, bounded too-small-page retry, errors after valid prefixes, valid-checksum row substitution, all unavailable native read states, truncation/trailing bytes, cancellation before/during/after IO (including after a decoded prefix), exceptions and retirement charges.

Three new codec framing cases check exact 12-byte prefix/schema/size boundaries, min/max/u32 overflow and that framing does not certify checksum/payload integrity. Existing golden/CRC/native-name/metadata cases remain regression coverage.

One native synthetic 100000-record case per host verifies every row ID/name, logical size/kind/hidden state, exact summed wire count, bounded pages, repeated End and file/budget cleanup. It retains one page and no full-row address table. This is cache storage/scanning, not directory enumeration/sorting/UI scale qualification.

limitations: WP-01 remains in progress; WP-02 through WP-08 unstarted.

Sequential cache scan only: real-directory disk-index collection, duplicate-name/source-change validation, external sorting/address persistence, indexed pane providers and destination preservation/collision inspection remain required.
Native workload is synthetic data in one private cache file, not 100000 real directory entries. It does not establish full-app memory/RSS/latency thresholds or real-terminal responsiveness.

Page wire/row bounds constrain returned records and logical successful data transfers (+one12-byte lookahead), not physical read-ahead/metadata IO, process RSS, caller retention or OS page cache. No RAM fallback or whole-list offset table.

End revalidates private file size and complete stored row sequence, not source enumeration End, filesystem snapshot, native acquisition authority or preservation proof. CRC remains accidental-corruption detection, not authentication.

All store/factory/budget calls worker-serialized. Native calls can block; cancellation cooperative. Page-size retry must increase bounds or report failure, not busy-loop. Corruption/IO/cancellation/exception revokes store and discards page prefix.
Existing APFS/ext4/ReFS coverage/admission rules unchanged. Different-account impersonation, native crash/full-disk/provider and broader filesystem matrix remain unqualified.
Focused sanitizer scope eleven units: codec17+store34+native13/11/10 cases. ASan+UBSan on Mac/Linux, Linux leak detector enabled, Apple leak detector unavailable/disabled; Windows ASan only.
